articles.summary: BOULDER, Colorado – January 4, 2024 – OnKure, Inc. today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has cleared the Investigational New Drug (IND) application of OKI-219, a potential best-in-class, mutant selective PI3KαH1047R inhibitor, for clinical evaluation. H1047R is the most common mutation in PI3Kα, being found in 15% of breast cancer andRead More
articles.title: OnKure Announces IND Clearance by U.S. FDA Enabling Phase 1 Initiation for its Mutant Selective PI3Kα inhibitor, OKI-219
